description: Requires a TechFabric engineer's Microsoft sign-in (scope blog.write). A read: what your agent needs to draft a LinkedIn post about a published techfabric.com post, any post on the site. Its key points and first-hand sentences, its link with the LinkedIn campaign, the engineer's voice notes, the social rules and LinkedIn's lengths. No model is called and nothing is posted: draft the post from it, check it with lint_social, and show the engineer the text to post themselves.

post.description: A published post on techfabric.com: its URL (https://www.techfabric.com/blog/<slug>) or its slug

name: social_post_kit

first_hand.description: Sentences of the post's own first-hand account, as published: the only experience the LinkedIn post may claim

link.description: The post's link to put in the LinkedIn post: its canonical URL with the LinkedIn campaign

title: LinkedIn kit for a post
